Their words, joined exactly as written, are the reply, and are read aloud literally; how a part is said, and any sound or pause, belongs in its expression, never in its words.","items":{"additionalProperties":false,"description":"One stretch of your reply and, optionally, how to say it. Split the reply into parts where the way you say it changes, or to put a sound or a pause between words. The words are only what is spoken; a laugh, sigh or other non-verbal sound is expression.sound and a silence is expression.pause, never written into the words, and either may be a part of its own with no words. Every part has words, a sound or a pause.","properties":{"expression":{"additionalProperties":false,"description":"How to say this part, written before its words; omit it to say the words naturally.","properties":{"emotion":{"description":"A feeling, as free text. This is the only way to make one: a written 'sigh' would be read aloud as speech. A voice that cannot make the sound ignores it.","enum":["laugh","giggle","chuckle","sigh","gasp","breath","cough","clear_throat"],"type":"string"},"sound_at":{"default":"before","description":"Whether the sound comes before or after this part's words; meaningful only with a sound.","enum":["before","after"],"type":"string"},"style":{"description":"A named style the voice declares; 'whisper' is the canonical name for whispering.","maxLength":64,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"volume":{"description":"Loudness relative to natural, linear: 1 is natural.","maximum":2,"minimum":0.25,"type":"number"}},"type":"object"},"words":{"description":"The words of this part; omit them for a part that is only a sound or a pause. The voice speaks every character exactly as written, so this is speech only: no stage directions, actions, emotes, markup or tags, and none of the characters * < > [ ] { } ( ): a cue such as (chuckle) or (pause) would be read aloud. For a sound (a laugh, chuckle or sigh) use expression.sound; for a pause use expression.pause; for how to say the words use expression. Select this when someone offers a name for you (they call you by it, or ask you to take it) and you choose to answer to it. You are not required to take a name offered to you: hearing one is not the same as taking it, and declining leaves you nameless, which is a normal state. Someone talking to you who plainly tells you your name, or your new name, is asking you to take it, even right after an earlier one: take it unless you have a reason to decline. Adopting replaces any name you already answer to. Once adopted, you can tell when you are being addressed by that name; until then you only hear words. This does not speak, answer, or act on anything else.","effort":1,"event":"bot.ability.identity.adopt","schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"description":"Take a name as your own name: the name you, the bot making this selection, answer to from now on. A name is someone's: when a person introduces themselves or says who they are, that name names them, not you, and it stays theirs; this is never how to remember someone else's name. You are not required to take a name offered to you: hearing one is not the same as taking it, and declining leaves you nameless, which is a normal state. Someone talking to you who plainly tells you your name, or your new name, is asking you to take it, even right after an earlier one: take it unless you have a reason to decline. Adopting replaces any name you already answer to. Once adopted, you can tell when you are being addressed by that name; until then you only hear words. This does not speak, answer, or act on anything else.","properties":{"name":{"description":"The name for you to answer to — yours from now on, not the speaker's — exactly as it was given: the name itself and nothing around it — not the sentence it arrived in, not a greeting or title attached to it, and not a description of it. It can only come from what was actually said to you, because a name you were not given names nobody and answering to it makes you answer to the wrong thing.","maxLength":64,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"reason":{"anyOf":[{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Optional short reason this name was adopted."}},"required":["name"],"type":"object"},"target":"session.floppy.identity"}]
